findings.text: Potrzebny jest wielokrotny wysiłek powtarzania wybranej czynności.
findings.why: The item never says how often to repeat. In the study the volunteers carried the behaviour out daily in the same context for 12 weeks, and the upstream cost line states daily repetition for several months. The word 'wielokrotny' fits weekly or occasional repetition, to which the 18 to 254 day figures do not apply. A reader can underestimate the effort (every day, for weeks to many months) and apply the range to a different frequency. Neither the title, Koszt, W praktyce nor Korzyść i dowody mentions daily performance.

findings.fix_direction: State the studied frequency (daily performance) and duration in the cost and practice fields, and say the timings do not carry over to less frequent repetition.

findings.why: The median of 66 days is not in the stored abstract and not in the upstream span; both give only a range. findings.text: Obserwuj regularność, zamiast uznawać brak automatyzmu po 21 dniach za porażkę.
findings.why: The upstream reassurance that a missed day does not reset progress is dropped, although the stored abstract supports it and it is the fallback for a reader who breaks the routine. 'Obserwuj regularność' without it invites streak-counting and restarting after one miss. The omission is not disclosed in Zmiany w adaptacji.
